selection_basis: Incident decision is an uncovered required properties/fire target with importance 3. The frozen FDMA incident guidance and registered MHLW SDS Sections 5–7 provide reproducible, material-specific response propositions without reopening already-covered prevention or extinguishing recall paths.

pinpoint_scope: FDMA『一般取扱所における火災対策のポイント』の漏えい・着火・換気・清掃・接地・火気管理・設備故障の該当施設/事故 subsection
一つの登録済みMHLW model SDSの Section 5『火災時の措置』、Section 6『漏出時の措置』またはSection 7『取扱い及び保管上の注意』の明示された field
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must bind to one registered source/version and one exact named subsection or SDS field. Do not compare instructions across materials or sources; questions must remain incident-decision propositions rather than duplicate prevention or extinguishing recall.

planned_families: personnel-protection, notification or access-control decisions where directly sourced
material-specific SDS response prohibitions and safe-action priorities
equipment-failure, grounding, cleaning or maintenance incident decisions tied to a named official subsection
